note: Curated facts from primary official documents only (company investor-relations pages and filings). Each event carries its source URL and an exact quote. A category with no entry means no verified entry in this dataset, not that nothing happened. Values are null where the source does not give one.

events.title: Capital expenditure for FY2024-25 (year ended 31 March 2025), actual
events.description: Capital expenditure reported by the company for the full financial year FY2024-25 (1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025). It is the amount spent, not an approved or planned amount, and it is a full-year figure, not a quarter.
events.source_name: Reliance Industries - Media Release, Q4 FY2024-25 (company)
events.evidence_quote: Capital Expenditure for the year ended March 31, 2025, was ₹ 131,107 crore ($ 15.3 billion).

events.title: Jio announces agreement with SpaceX for Starlink broadband services in India
events.description: Agreement announced during the quarter ended 31 March 2025. No value or completion status is given in the sentence.
events.source_name: Reliance Industries - Media Release, Q4 FY2024-25 (company)
events.evidence_quote: During the quarter, Jio announced an agreement with SpaceX to offer Starlink's broadband internet services to its customers in India.

events.title: Deal win with SKF (US$ 800 million), listed in Q1 FY2026-27 highlights
events.description: A single deal win named in the release for the quarter. The release does not say whether it is included in, or additional to, any quarterly total, so this amount must not be added to any other figure. Execution period is not stated in the quoted sentence.
events.source_name: Tata Consultancy Services - Press Release, Q1 FY2026-27 (company)
events.evidence_quote: Won a landmark US$800 million global AI-led business transformation deal with SKF; redesigning enterprise operations around an intelligent digital core.

events.title: Infosys announces joint venture with Telstra, acquiring 75% of Versent Group
events.description: Announced in the Q2 FY2025-26 press release. The release does not state that the transaction is completed. No transaction value is given in the quoted sentence.
events.evidence_quote: Infosys announced a joint venture with Telstra, in Australia, by acquiring 75% of the shareholding in Versent Group, a wholly owned subsidiary of Telstra Group, to propel AI-enabled cloud and digital solutions for enterprises.

events.title: Large deal wins TCV for Q2 FY2025-26
events.description: Total contract value of large deals won in the quarter, as reported by the company. It is not an order book.
events.evidence_quote: TCV of large deal wins was $3.1 billion, with net new of 67%.

events.title: Order inflow for FY2025-26
events.description: Order inflow for the full year FY2025-26 (year ended 31 March 2026), from the Key Financial Indicators table (amounts in ₹ bn; columns FY25, FY26, y-o-y). FY25 was 3566 and the y-o-y change is shown as 22%. Order inflow is not the order book.
events.source_name: Larsen & Toubro - Earnings Call Presentation Q4/FY2025-26 (company filing on NSE)
events.evidence_quote: Key Financial Indicators | (Amount in ₹ bn) | FY25 | FY26 | (y-o-y) | Order Inflow | 3566 | 4356 | 22%

events.title: Order book as of 31 March 2026

events.source_name: Larsen & Toubro - Earnings Call Presentation Q4/FY2025-26 (company filing on NSE)
events.evidence_quote: Key Financial Indicators | (Amount in ₹ bn) | As on Mar'25 | As on Mar'26 | Order Book | 5791 | 7403 | 28%

events.title: Second plant in Kharkhoda commissioned
events.description: The release says the company commissioned its second plant in Kharkhoda. No capacity figure is given in the quoted sentence.

events.evidence_quote: Higher sales were possible because the Company commissioned its second plant in Kharkhoda.

events.title: Board approves 4 CBG manufacturing projects (first phase)
events.description: Compressed biogas projects approved by the Board. The amount is stated as a project budget, not as capital expenditure spent or planned.

events.evidence_quote: The Board also approved 4 CBG projects in the first phase with a budget of INR 5,610 million.

events.title: Consolidated capex for Q4 FY2025-26 (actual)
events.description: Capex for the quarter as reported under the consolidated results. Spent amount, not an approved or planned amount.
events.source_name: Bharti Airtel - Media Release, Q4 FY2025-26 (company)
events.evidence_quote: Capex for the quarter stood at Rs 16,066 crore.

events.title: Third-party US$ 1 billion investment into Nxtra Data Limited announced (not Airtel capex)
events.description: Investment by other investors (Alpha Wave Global, Carlyle and Anchorage Capital, through their affiliates) into Airtel's data centre subsidiary Nxtra, announced in the quarter. It is third-party investment into the subsidiary, not Airtel's own capex, and no completion is stated.
events.source_name: Bharti Airtel - Media Release, Q4 FY2025-26 (company)
events.evidence_quote: During the quarter, Airtel announced investment of US$ 1 Billion by Alpha Wave Global, Carlyle and Anchorage Capital, through their affiliates, in Nxtra Data Limited ("Nxtra"), a subsidiary of Bharti Airtel engaged in the data center business, to expand its network across India and accelerate growth.

events.title: Airtel Money Limited NBFC: capitalisation of Rs 20,000 crore planned
events.description: A planned capitalisation initiative for the NBFC subsidiary. The release says the amount will be injected over the next few years, so it is planned, not completed. It is a capital injection, not capex.
events.source_name: Bharti Airtel - Media Release, Q4 FY2025-26 (company)
events.evidence_quote: The NBFC subsidiary will be capitalised with Rs 20,000 crore to be injected over the next few years.

events.title: Nicotine and Nicotine derivative products facility: shipments commenced
events.description: Shipments from the facility commenced in Q4 FY2024-25. No capacity figure is given in the quoted sentence.
events.evidence_quote: Post extensive product development and customer trials, shipments from the state-of-the-art facility to manufacture and export Nicotine and Nicotine derivative products have commenced in Q4 FY25.

events.title: Business Transfer Agreement to acquire Century Pulp and Paper undertaking

events.evidence_quote: The Company also entered into a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the Pulp and Paper Undertaking of Aditya Birla Real Estate Limited (Century Pulp and Paper).
